==Notes==
* Sometimes used with [[Focused Anger]] or [["For Great Justice!"]] in order to quickly fuel [["Save Yourselves!"]] right before engaging a fight.  
{{anomaly|This skill does not trigger any [[energy]] gain from Leadership, even for affecting the skill user.}}
{{bug|"Make Your Time!" counts ''all'' [[Ally|allies]], not just party members.}}

==Trivia==
* The phrase "make your time" comes from the English (European) translation of the video game [[w:Zero_Wing|Zero Wing]], which is also the source of the "[[For Great Justice!]]" skill name and the "[[w:All your base are belong to us|All your base are belong to us]]" phrase.
* The figure in this [[skill icon]] is seemingly the same figure on the left of the [["Never Give Up!"]] icon.
* The Paragon in the icon appears to be wearing [[Paragon Elite Sunspear armor|Elite Sunspear armor]].
